overview: The Medford Jazz Festival opened its 2022 outdoor festival at the West Medford Community Center. The evening featured jazz and spoken-word performances by the Beacon Blue Jazz Quintet and The Ally Project.

items.title: Opening Remarks
items.summary: Medford Poet Laureate Terry Carter and festival producer Jonathan Fagan welcomed attendees to the West Medford Community Center and recognized organizational partners and sponsors.

items.title: Beacon Blue Jazz Quintet Performance
items.summary: The Beacon Blue Jazz Quintet performed an opening set of jazz standards and original compositions directed by Jonathan Fagan.

items.title: The Ally Project Performance
items.summary: The Ally Project performed a set pairing jazz instrumentation with Terry Carter's spoken-word poetry addressing social justice, gentrification, and West Medford history.
